g.text: Session State Layers and CampusClaw Target Model
The Session identity does not include modelId.
Changing the default model keeps the same Session.
Each Run freezes its own modelId and thinking value.
The strong ETag identifies the complete public projection.
It changes with Session revision, active run sequence,
or history watermark. Full history remains paginated.
Credentials, caller claims, system prompts, Java objects,
raw tool context, stack traces, and replay internals are
never part of the public snapshot.
